name: bic-sukoon-village
description: Brisbane Islamic Centre and Sukoon Village — two separate websites built from one shared React codebase

scripts.build: npm run build:bic && npm run build:sukoon
scripts.build:bic: vite build --mode bic --outDir dist/bic --emptyOutDir && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs bic
scripts.build:sukoon: vite build --mode sukoon --outDir dist/sukoon --emptyOutDir && node scripts/generate-sitemap.mjs sukoon
